**Finding resubmitted: compliant** (paragraphs unchanged, no redline, no comment).

The repair addresses the one flagged item — the deterministic duration check — by pinning the analysis to the exact wording:

- **Duration artifact resolved:** § 19.2 writes the period as "ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later." The threshold check looked for a numeric/month-year expression and so did not match the spelled-out figure. The clause in substance gives a 90-day Deliverable conformance period, measured from the *later* of delivery or acceptance, which satisfies the preferred 90-day benchmark; hosted Services must conform "throughout the subscription term," exceeding the 12-month software benchmark.
- **Warranty substance:** professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel plus material conformance to documentation and specifications (§ 19.1); no malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law (§ 19.3).
- **Remedy:** prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, then termination and refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims (§ 19.4).
- **Disclaimer:** limited to implied warranties and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy (§ 19.5) — no "AS IS" walk-away exposure.

No material term falls short of the preferred position, so the clause stands as drafted.
